verdict.rationale: No evidence describes scoped or least-privilege API credential/permission management for agents; Docusign's docs mention OAuth/API SDKs and an MCP connector but nothing about issuing restricted-scope credentials for AI agents, and a community report even describes a permissions bypass issue rather than fine-grained scoping. Missing for 10: documented scoped OAuth/API key creation, permission granularity controls, and any agent-specific credential issuance mechanism.
